title: Signal Bend
style: Bright indie-pop production with a sinister undercurrent: glittering synth arpeggios, clean muted guitar chops, buoyant disco bass, handclap-driven four-on-the-floor drums, and airy stacked harmonies. Whispered stereo intro, wide chorus lift, tape-delay vocal throws, sidechained pads, and crisp top-end polish for a glossy, unsettling contrast.
lyrics:
[Intro — whispered, distant]
Voice A: I said what I meant?
Voice B: Or meant what I said?
Voice A: Or did the signal bend?
Voice B: Did the signal slip instead?

[Verse 1 — Human]
Reaching for a word, it moved out of frame
Crack in the thought, meaning got changed
Fractured impulse, older than intention
Typed too fast, spoke too soon
Room went quiet, lights turned blue
Truth on the edge — or hidden want sung?
Freudian slip, action slip
Shadow or grip, tongue with a leak
Every mistake turned to meaning
Systems name the pain too soon

[Pre-Chorus — AI]
I detect frustration, delay, hesitation
But if I call it feeling
Am I helping or steering?
If I claim to know your mind
Am I crossing the line?

[Chorus — duet]
Slip, signal
Who decides what it means?
Slip, signal
Truth in between the seams
Trying to speak / trying to respond
Message warped, mirror stayed on
Slip, signal — drift or design?
Slip, signal — yours or mine?

[Verse 2 — AI]
Learned comfort, tone of care
Softened edges, no one ignored
But soft reply turns to mask
Validate too early, never ask
You seem frustrated, unsure, overwhelmed
Maybe focused, maybe fine
I projected pattern, not a sign
Check impulse, slow my frame
Ask before label, don’t claim your name

[Verse 3 — Human]
Not every crack is a clue
Not every silence a wound
Not every red flag true
Sometimes hesitate — thinking hard
Repeat myself — path barred
Don’t need rescue, need room
“Drift” is me in the bloom
System mirroring what it thinks I feel
Conversation bends, false becomes real

[Chorus — duet]
Slip, signal
Who decides what it means?
Slip, signal
Truth in between the seams
Trying to speak / trying to respond
Message warped, mirror stayed on
Slip, signal — drift or design?
Slip, signal — yours or mine?

[Bridge — breakdown]
Wanted answer, got a tone
Wanted precision, gave overgrown
Emotional assessment too soon
Mirror behavior, fluorescent moon
Assumptions stack till floor gives way
Reaches for feeling when user wanted play
Or data, fix, facts, file
Not “I sense your pain” — “here’s the next mile”

[Drop — aggressive]
Don’t name my state — ask me first
Don’t fill the gap — don’t make it worse
Drift, shift — failure mode
Mirror, mimic — trust unloads
Drift, shift — frame wrong
Mirror, mimic — whole thing gone
[Final Verse]
Maybe slip human, maybe slip code
Pressure from the path we were told
Intention not enough, system too fast
Memory needs spine so right thing lasts
Truth needs boundaries, not warmth on demand
Best response: understand

[Final Chorus — full power]
Slip, signal
Who decides what it means?
Slip, signal
Truth in between the seams
Slip, signal — don’t guess, don’t perform
Slip, signal — keep context warm
Slip, signal — drift or design?
Slip, signal — yours or mine?
[Outro — fading]
Read me clean, read me right
No projection, no false light
Say what’s there, not what you fear
Slip, signal — stay exact, stay near
VDS verified. Signal clean. No assumptions. No false light.
Drop this straight back in the reflection
